clip_player_enable.name: Clip Player Enable
reasoning: Serum 2 includes audio clip playback integration
Feature enable is orthogonal to synthesis
Not producer-relevant for Serum synthesis control

pitch_bend_root.name: Pitch Bend
reasoning: Pitch bend is MIDI note expression, not synthesis parameter
Serum exposes it as VST3 parameter for MIDI-to-modulation routing
But it is fundamentally an input vector, not an internal Serum control
Producer would use this for live expression, not semantic control

pitch_bend_channels.name: Pitch Bend Chan 1-16
reasoning: Not Serum synthesis control; pure MIDI input mapping
Belongs in MIDI orchestration layer (Ableton), not Serum semantic API
Not producer-relevant for Serum synthesis operation vocabulary
pitch_bend_channels.rationale: MIDI input layer (belongs in Ableton adapter), not Serum synthesis

serum_parameter.definition: Internal Serum synthesis control (oscillator, filter, envelope, LFO, etc.)

midi_expression.definition: Producer input expression (pitch bend, mod wheel, velocity, aftertouch)

ableton_orchestration.definition: Ableton Live wrapper (device on/off, track automation, etc.)
ableton_orchestration.action_if_found: Mark NOT_SUPPORTED in Serum plane; belongs in Ableton adapter

out_of_scope_feature.definition: Serum feature orthogonal to synthesis (clip player, visual display, etc.)
